reserveReview.rationale: Midas identifies mGLOBAL as exposure to Fasanara receivables and asset-based finance. On September 14 the latest visible aggregate proof-of-reserve report was dated July 13; current product TVL and operational wallets do not refresh that report or disclose a current loan tape. The reserve remains one unresolved private-credit strategy envelope. Redemption-liquidity targets are policy disclosures, not measured reserve-line weights. September 15 onchain registry and IPFS follow-up confirmed that July 13 is the attestation publication date, while its JTC fund-manager claim explicitly values Fasanara SA SICAV-RAIF, mGLOBAL Fund, SF 36, Class A USD ACC as of May 31, 2026. The claim reports $34,462,903.46 fund value and $21,841,041.59 pending subscription. These older, distinct amounts cannot be combined with current operational wallet balances or treated as current held fund shares. Supplemental source-access check 2026-10-09 by Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (Lane51Tokenised): direct product, transparency and legal-documentation reads returned HTTP 403; alternate extraction supplied only shared footer disclosures. A browser subsequently recovered the mGLOBAL dashboard, which displayed a latest September 28 PoR/NAV checkpoint, $65.30M gross AUM and $65.25M snapshot TVL, distinct from its $34.06M live product TVL. The displayed aggregate comparison and operational wallet list did not provide a constituent allocation. The attestation itself could not be inspected because concurrent browser sessions shared and changed the relay target. The June 23 strategy article and October 2 September recap remain readable, but neither supplies a complete dated holdings mix. This incomplete report recovery is not evidence of issuer non-disclosure. The campaign leaves the composition cause unresearched pending the underlying current attestation and manager report; no dates, weights or assurance have been refreshed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas issuer strategy disclosure plus independent rwa.xyz Asset-Backed Credit / Fasanara Global Fund envelope; no published constituent weights
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Loan-level weights, obligors, originators, warehouse facilities and cash-versus-receivables allocation remain unverified. Source-maintenance check 2026-10-07: mGLOBAL API updatedAt=2026-10-07T20:08:00.124Z labels 93.83% USDT and 6.17% Aave USDC, but the official June 23 structure describes receivables/digital invoices/asset-based finance and general_wallet is unmapped. Do not promote that label to verified Tether reserves. The retained July SAVE CID's manager valuation is May 31 and ops claim June 29; publication or proof update cannot renew valuation. Exact equity/NAV agreement may echo the September 24 NAV rather than prove constituents. Preserve the 4000000-second NAV cap; monthly manager reporting does not authorize that age for loan-level composition. Supplemental source recovery 2026-10-09 by Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (W2L21Alchemix) supersedes the earlier browser-collision access blocker, not the reserve review or composition dates: September 28 registry transaction 0x9297ef8430eacbfaa91732be7c8350c4471ab5846ed29c9f6bc8a1d5afa29b9c at Ethereum block 26075343 points to attestation e8ceed07773f32cc481930b91ad1d5667e1276be5235869af56dcbaf55b129f3. The recovered gzip object's reconstructed UnixFS DAG-PB SHA-256 exactly matches that hash. Its metadata createdAt is 2026-09-28T10:25:21.435Z and expiresAt is 2026-10-05T10:25:21.435Z, but the embedded JTC email values Fasanara SA SICAV-RAIF, mGLOBAL Fund, SF 36, Class A USD ACC as of July 31, 2026 at $60,921,529.12 with $134,760 pending subscription. The separate onetoken_report explicitly anchors to July 31 at 23:59:59 UTC, not September 28. The document reports $65,296,469.78 gross reserves and $65,249,665.15 TVL, not underlying loan weights. Its Midas signature and TLS-notary proof were not independently validated; content-hash binding is not reserve assurance. A separately recovered September 28 10:00 UTC API protocol-equity split of 90.71% general_wallet/unmapped and 9.29% Aave is not this attestation's embedded July snapshot or proven whole-economic-reserve mix. Curated dates, weights, confidence and unresolved strategy envelope remain unchanged.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of the Midas Aave Horizon post reconfirms issuance through a dedicated compartment of a bankruptcy-remote Luxembourg Securitisation Vehicle and monthly independent valuation by JTC Luxembourg (supports segregated assets and structured bankruptcy-remoteness). It still does not name the custodian(s) safekeeping underlying receivables or cash accounts, does not publish provider shares, and discloses no rehypothecation terms; zero fund-level leverage is not a reuse prohibition. Fordefi remains a platform-level on-chain custody technology claim from Midas transparency listings rather than a mGLOBAL-specific custody document. The compartment is an exempt Luxembourg securitisation undertaking, not a prudentially supervised fund.
